- Criterion by criterion: met — the fact that Pell’s Saturday sales had also been flat for years is new and not already in the premises, and it makes Ardley’s case more like the case in which the move raised sales. Met — the answer explains that this likeness makes the same sales jump more likely.
- Tip: A new likeness between the source case and the target case is a valid strengthener when you say why that likeness matters.

- Tip: State only what must be true for the gap not to be fully explained by something else, not that the groups were identical in every other respect.
